Discovery Point

Building

Stats

Overview

Discovery Point is a 6-story Class A office building with approximately 360,000 RSF and recently underwent multi-million dollar renovations. The building offers the largest and efficient multi-story floor plates in the Central Florida Research Park and with up to 11,235 RSF available, it has the most contiguous office space in East Orlando.

Highlights
